turns.reply: The trailing-backslash branch of `escape` is wrong for runs of three or more backslashes: `endswith("\\\\")` is true for any run of two or more, so an odd run like `\\\` gets no extra escape and would swallow the next tag's bracket. I'll change it to count the trailing run and add one backslash only when the count is odd.

markup = _escape(escape_backslashes, markup)
    trailing_backslashes = len(markup) - len(markup.rstrip("\\"))
    if trailing_backslashes % 2:
        return markup + "\\"

    return markup
